annotations.text:
Fin·Esse — page-wise layout, warm editorial.
Bone ground, warm charcoal ink, moss accent, clay for anything wrong.
Schibsted Grotesk for text, IBM Plex Mono for every figure.
All numbers are real output from the app's engine, not placeholders.

The agent rail is pinned on every page — approvals and the live tool trail are global state, not a page.

Only the approval gets card chrome: it is the one thing asking you to act.
